resources.remote_code_release_archive_reason: Release transport artifact is separate from method data payload and is not measured by this evaluator
resources.unmeasured_reason: CPU only; no deployment package/transfer measured; RSS null if runtime unavailable; inner gradient/kernel times only included in measured training step wall time
resources.fitted_state_scope: Full numeric geometry plus LocalRidge head and 16-byte theta; excludes original frozen Phase1 model delivery, cache, Python and serialization overhead
resources.interpretation: Stage duration sums measure work, not concurrent elapsed time. Shared preparation is charged once. Final scoring timings are measured on the stated CPU/thread configuration.

interpretation: R0 remains original LocalRidge. R_fixed is the untrained theta=(1,0) ablation. R_joint is the declared sequential candidate; R_reset changes C initialization and proximal anchor to zero.
Joint and reset share one trained B. C candidates share one preparation and inherited full old geometry, but inner-fold geometry is always re-estimated from that inner old training subset.
Only inner support error supervises theta. Inner-held labels are part of training and are never called independent validation.
Training uses exactly eight projected updates and a separate final objective, with no best-step selection. No-information stages skip updates and objective solves.
True K1 has no fitting or held score. Proxy trainK1 uses exact R0 identity forward for every path; no K1 benefit is claimed.
A is unavailable; B minus B0 is a support-classifier increment, not B minus ground A.
OOF pools each physical held row once. Proxy averages all anchors within parent then weights parents equally.
Old-only reuse and repeated old support across new-count rows are not independent observations.
Two trainable scalars do not imply low total compute or a 16-byte deployed model; full geometry/head state and repeated inner solves are counted.
10/1/3 percentage-point ideal directions are descriptive and impose no automatic promotion gate.
